name: Pamplonita (Colombia)
description: Orange field with a yellow rising sun above narrow stripes of blue and white and a green base.
history: Municipal flag of Pamplonita, a municipality in the department of Norte de Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: broad orange field over narrow blue and white stripes and a green base
